items.en: A memory stone. A minute of silence… then a minute of gossip. Sorry, habit.

items.title: Supplementaries Oddity

items.title: Supplementaries Oddity
items.en: Strange item, strange owner, excellent day. We will put it in the chronicle.

items.title: Supplementaries Oddity

items.title: Comforts Sleeping Bag
items.en: A Comforts sleeping bag — a traveler's bed. Just do not unroll it on my crops!

items.title: Comforts Sleeping Bag
items.en: Sleep where you like, as long as you snore softer than pigs. Almost good night.

items.title: Comforts Sleeping Bag

items.en: Iron boxes hum smarter than me. I am not offended. Almost.

items.title: Place Mekanism Machine

items.en: You are boxing a sun. We are packing suitcases. Joke. But the suitcases are nearby.

items.title: Place a Mekanism Reactor Part

items.en_tts: A reactor in the yard. The bell is already nervous. So is the mayor.
items.ru_tts: Реактор во дворе. Колокол уже нервничает. И мэр тоже.

items.title: Hold Uranium or Nuclear Waste
items.en: Uranium in hand — glowing with pride or radiation? Keep it off the crops!

items.en_tts: Uranium in hand — glowing with pride or radiation? Keep it off the crops!
items.ru_tts: Уран в руках — светитесь от гордости или от радиации? Отставьте от грядок!

items.en_tts: Waste looks unappetizing even for compost. Bury it farther away… please.

items.title: Hold Uranium or Nuclear Waste
items.en: A glowing souvenir. We pick a darker corner. Farther.

items.en_tts: A glowing souvenir. We pick a darker corner. Farther.
items.ru_tts: Светящийся сувенир. Мы выбираем тёмный угол. Дальше, пожалуйста, от грядок.

items.ru_tts: Реактор Create Nuclear — кинетика с характером. Не ставьте это вместо печки!

items.title: Place Create Nuclear Reactor Parts
items.en: A nuclear setup in the yard. Neighbors write a petition. I sign first.

items.en_tts: Enriching fire — sounds like a spa day for ore. For villagers it means stay back.

items.ru_tts: Огонь, который учит руду быть умнее. Нас он тоже учит — бегать.

items.ru_tts: Заводской блок TFMG — копоть уже в меню ужина. Вентиляцию обещали?

items.en: Industry walks into the village in work boots. The crops ask for masks.

items.en: Black sludge and white shirts are poor friends. We wear white. Well, we did.

items.title: Place Aeronautics Parts

items.en: A shadow from above. Not a dragon. Worse — an engineer. Hide the pumpkins.

items.ru_tts: Тень с неба. Не дракон. Хуже — инженер. Прячьте тыквы.

items.en: A jetpack — a walking firework with ego. Take off away from the crops, please.

items.en: You look like a comet, only louder and closer. We cheer from below… and squint.
